# Temple Scroll Column 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 8 | **Condition:** Fragmentary; Wood Offering Festival

---

**8:1** [...] the-offering of-wood [...] the-priests shall-offer first [...]

**8:2** [...] they-shall-place [it] upon the-fire of-the-altar of-burnt-offering [...]

**8:3** [...] and-after-them the-Levites shall-offer [...]

**8:4** [...] and-then the-sons-of-Israel shall-offer by-their-tribes [...]

**8:5** [...] two-tribes each day [...]

**8:6** [...] on-the-first day Levi and-Judah [...]

**8:7** [...] on-the-second day Benjamin and-the-sons-of-Joseph [...]

**8:8** [...] Ephraim and-Manasseh [...]

**8:9** [...] and-they-shall-bring the-wood [...] upon the-altar [...]

**8:10** [...] and-the-priests shall-burn it upon the-altar of-the-burnt-offering [...]

**8:11** [...] for-all the-burnt-offerings and-for-all the-sacrifices [...]

**8:12** [...] day by-day [...] according-to the-commandment [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 8 legislates the Wood Offering Festival (qorban ha-'etsim), unique to the Temple Scroll (cf. Neh 10:35, 13:31 for the only biblical references to wood offerings). Two tribes contribute wood each day over six days. The order begins with Levi and Judah (day one), then Benjamin and the sons of Joseph — Ephraim and Manasseh (day two). The hierarchical structure (priests, Levites, Israel) governs the offering order within each day.*
